scope: Targeted source and primary-publication review of five biological neural models. This is research evidence, not an executable asset allowlist.

method.pins: Default-branch HEAD snapshots checked with git ls-remote; these are not claimed to be the exact commits used in the publications.
method.file_verification: Recomputed Git blob SHA-1 from inspected file bytes. Connector-normalized text was replaced by original GitHub REST blob bytes for the one differing file. SHA-256 digests are retained below.
method.source_inspection: Selected READMEs, licenses, dependency metadata and model/loader entry points; not a complete line-by-line or independent professional security audit.
method.static_checks: Six selected Python files parsed with Python 3.12.14 ast.parse without importing or executing upstream code.
method.scientific_review: Original peer-reviewed papers, their code/data availability statements, repository references and scoped biological validation claims; two later arXiv abstracts reviewed as unreplicated preprint critiques.
not_performed: Replication of paper figures or statistics
Live deployment, wallet access or transactions

models.paper_code_link: Final Nature paper data/code-availability statements explicitly link TuragaLab/flyvis; official repository README links the same final paper. Paper identity and biological scope also cross-checked against PubMed.
models.biological_scope: Connectome-constrained, task-optimized optic-lobe motion-vision network covering 64 cell types; not a whole fly brain.
models.author_reported_validation: Neural-response predictions compared with experiments across 26 studies, including contrast and motion tuning. Unknown dynamics are optimized for visual motion, not measured directly.

asset_rights.detail: Separate pretrained weights, connectome inputs and stimulus/training-data terms were not cleared by this audit. Code MIT alone is insufficient.

runtime.detail: Current project Python 3.14 CI is outside the upstream range. Optional pretrained dependencies contain older exact pins; select and lock a separate compatible environment.

security_findings.observation: torch.load(..., weights_only=False) explicitly enables general checkpoint deserialization.
security_findings.boundary: Do not load untrusted weights in a service holding secrets; verify origin and digest, inspect serialization, and use an isolated reproduction worker.

models.recommendation: First candidate for an isolated biological reference reproduction, conditional on asset permissions, pinned artifacts and environment compatibility.

models.paper_code_link: Final paper explicitly names this GitHub repository. The pinned README still cites the earlier 2023 preprint.
models.biological_scope: Brain-wide FlyWire-based leaky integrate-and-fire model; evaluated sensorimotor circuits concern feeding and antennal grooming, not all fly behaviors or cognition.
models.author_reported_validation: Taste and feeding-circuit predictions compared with neural and behavioral evidence, including optogenetic tests; grooming circuit supplies a separate biological evaluation.

asset_rights.detail: README defaults to paper-used FlyWire 630 and describes a 783 alternative. Public FlyWire 783 guidelines state CC BY-NC 4.0; do not infer terms for 630 or commercial permission from the code license.

runtime.detail: pandas/parquet and optional compiled simulation path; multi-core defaults need an explicit resource bound. No dependency installation or simulation performed.

models.recommendation: Biological circuit research candidate after exact data/version rights and environment review; no commercial promotion from this audit.

models.paper_code_link: Final paper's data-availability statement links CNS ModelDB 267146; ModelDB record and mirrored repository identify Ferrario et al. The separate virtual-body code is not audited here.
models.biological_scope: Modeled touch-to-swimming hindbrain/spinal circuitry, approximately 2300 neurons in 12 classes; not a measured whole tadpole cognitive brain.
models.author_reported_validation: CNS motor patterns compared with physiological/behavioral observations and supplied to a separate virtual-body model. Some connectivity and sensory-memory populations remain modeled hypotheses.

code_license.detail: No license-named file in the complete 105-blob tree at this pin. Selected README and main entry point do not establish a reuse grant. This is not an exhaustive assertion that no permission exists anywhere.

asset_rights.detail: Article CC BY does not establish a separate source-code/data license.

runtime.framework: MATLAB anatomical stage plus NEURON-Python functional stage
runtime.detail: Requires compiled NEURON mechanisms. Selected functional main.py fails Python 3.12 parsing at line 98 due to Python 2 print syntax; this is a static incompatibility, not a simulation result.

models.recommendation: Retain as a distinct executable-model candidate, separate from the 2017 tadpole study; resolve code terms and legacy-runtime/porting requirements before integration.

models.paper_code_link: Final paper directly links mozaik-models/LSV1M and the separate Mozaik framework.
models.biological_scope: Spiking model of cat V1 layers 4 and 2/3 in a central cortical patch; not a complete cat brain.
models.author_reported_validation: Anatomical and physiological constraints, spontaneous activity, visually driven conductances, orientation and size tuning compared with experimental evidence.

dependency_license.detail: This current framework snapshot is not claimed to be paper version 0.4 or the required compatible runtime. Model MIT does not replace the framework's separate terms.

asset_rights.detail: Stimulus files, recorded reference outputs and all transitive dependencies are not separately cleared.

runtime.author_reported_setup: 16 processes on EPYC 7302 CPU with 128 GB RAM
runtime.author_reported_runtime: Approximately 10 hours for listed full protocols and 1.5 hours for spontaneous-activity protocol on the described setup; not our measurements.
runtime.detail: Current README includes later protocols. Recover exact paper configuration and compatible framework before claiming replication.

models.recommendation: Later scientific reproduction requiring a measured resource budget; unsuitable as the first low-resource live-service integration.

models.paper_code_link: Original paper code availability and repository README identify the multi-area model and companion structural/stabilization papers.
models.biological_scope: Layer-resolved spiking model spanning 32 visual cortical areas, each represented by a local patch; not an entire monkey brain.
models.author_reported_validation: Resting-state spiking statistics and inter-area functional-connectivity patterns compared with biological observations, with dynamics dependent on coupling/stability assumptions.

code_license.detail: Source-available with a noncommercial restriction; do not label unrestricted commercial open source.

asset_rights.detail: Code noncommercial terms already prevent treating this as an unrestricted commercial dependency; data/output/dependency terms also require separate review.

runtime.framework: NEST with optional R/aod and MPI workflows
runtime.detail: Paper simulator version differs from later compatibility claims; full-scale simulation is a substantial HPC task, while documented downscaled examples are separate experiments.

models.recommendation: Research-only candidate pending permissions and a bounded reproduction budget.

supplementary_preprints.title: Topological Sensitivity in Connectome-Constrained Neural Networks
supplementary_preprints.review_scope: Abstract only; code and results not independently reproduced.
supplementary_preprints.finding: Reports that from-scratch initialization and degree-preserving controls remove apparent advantages in its flyvis-based experiments; does not establish a blanket refutation of original biological predictions.

supplementary_preprints.title: FlyHack: Stress-Testing Mechanistic Claims in a Connectome-Constrained Visual Model
supplementary_preprints.review_scope: Abstract only; code and results not independently reproduced.
supplementary_preprints.finding: Reports dependence of mechanistic conclusions on controls, interventions, representation and ensemble member; motivates stronger controls, not claims of our own replication.

inspected_files.normalization_note: Connector text differs from raw blob; source SHA-256 is computed from GitHub REST blob bytes.
